summary_en: BCJ-116, a special-purpose acquisition company established on October 21, 2026, launched a tender offer for all ordinary shares of Hokuriku Electric Industry at 4,180 yen per share from November 11 to December 23, 2026, targeting 7,848,927 shares with a minimum of 5,232,600 shares, backed by Bain Capital Private Equity as the ultimate controller.
title_en: Notice Regarding Commencement of Tender Offer for Ordinary Shares of Hokuriku Electric Industry Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 6989) by BCJ-116 Corporation
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, BCJ-116 Corporation announced the commencement of a tender offer for all ordinary shares of Hokuriku Electric Industry Co., Ltd., listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market. The offer price was set at 4,180 yen per share, with the tender offer period running from November 11 through December 23, 2026, covering 30 business days. The bidder targeted acquisition of 7,848,927 shares, with a minimum threshold of 5,232,600 shares and no specified maximum.

BCJ-116 is a special-purpose acquisition company established on October 21, 2026, with the stated primary objective of acquiring and controlling the target company's ordinary shares and business operations. The company is a wholly-owned subsidiary of BCJ-115, which is itself indirectly controlled by Bain Capital Private Equity, LP and its affiliated investment funds. Settlement of the tender offer was scheduled for December 30, 2026, with Nomura Securities serving as the tender offer agent. The disclosure provided the minimum share threshold but did not disclose an upper limit or the percentage of outstanding shares represented by the targeted acquisition.
